name: Iron Man Simulator LEGACY
desc:
The legacy version of IMS.
War Machine is free here!

Press Q to call a suit.
There is a 20 second cooldown after exploding your suit.

Controls:
Q - Call suit
Q/E/R - Repulsors/Chest Repulsor
N - Eject
M - Toggle mask
X - Remove suit
Backspace - Helmet off

Voice commands:
Power on/Power up
Power down/Power off/Cut power/Kill power
Eject
Break
Send suit/Call suit
